name: Holland Park Adventure Playground
description: Adventure playground in Holland Park for ages 5 to 14, with a 25-metre zip wire, a 10-person see-saw, a 10-person dragon swinger, a wheelchair-accessible roundabout and accessible swings. There's a separate toddler playground nearby. Children must be supervised.

nearby.label: Toilets in the playground, with baby change and an accessible toilet; more by the toddler playground

notConfirmed: Exact position, toddler playground equipment, café and parking. The council page was last updated in 2021.
